mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, email, password_hash, role, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM app_user ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, username, nickname, email, password_hash, role, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, nickname, email, password_hash, role, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM app_user WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (username, nickname, email, role, enabled) VALUES (#{username}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{role}, #{enabled})
INSERT INTO app_user (username, nickname, email, password_hash, role, enabled) VALUES (#{username}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET username=#{username}, nickname=#{nickname}, email=#{email}, role=#{role}, enabled=#{enabled}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE app_user SET password_hash=#{passwordHash}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
